_about: Every object in every 3D room, mapped to a product. `rooms` maps glTF root node names (a name also matches its `<name>_...` children, e.g. a blind's cassette) to product ids. A product is coming-soon until its CJdropshipping listing (backend/data/product-sourcing.tsv) is imported with `npm run fetch-cj -- <id> --apply`, which writes its price, photo and stock to lamp-offers.ts. Supplier ids and costs never live here.
